This is really misleading.

Dogecoin is merge-mined, so the marginal cost to attack it is _zero_; attacking Monero is much more expensive than that.

Prior example: Coiled Coin was merge-mined, and years ago one person with no budget 51% attacked it, killing the coin. https://t.co/ksnxF6jPyr

Reminder: Elon Musk is one of the founders of PayPal.

It shouldn't surprise you if he tries to turn Dogecoin into PayPal 2.0

But being able to tolerate high latency is what's required to become currency of the solar system.

Lightning on a long-block-interval coin can become the payment layer of the solar system. A 6 second block interval Dogecoin simply can't.

I'm surprised his goals are so low.

😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂

Dogecoin's block interval is already just 60 seconds. That's low enough that larger miners already have a big profit advantage over smaller ones.

A 6 second block interval with 10MB blocks would just break the consensus.

Musk should focus on rockets.
@clqr Note that Bitcoin has bigger tolerances than the 0.1s I quoted for a 60s interval (which happens to be what Dogecoin uses), because a 10 minute block interval gives you more lee-way.
